title: terebinthus odorata
intro: Terebinthus odorata, commonly known as Mastich, is a plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it effective in treating various health issues such as respiratory problems, digestive issues, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mastich include expectorant, mucolytic, and anti-spasmodic effects, which help in relieving coughs, congestion, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Mastich include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a popular natural remedy in traditional medicine.
